questions.stem: After drinking a large volume of water, what happens to ADH levels and urine volume?

options.text: ADH increases and urine volume decreases
ADH decreases and urine volume increases
ADH increases and urine volume increases
ADH decreases and urine volume decreases

questions.explanation: After drinking lots of water, the blood becomes more dilute. The hypothalamus detects this and less ADH is released. With less ADH, the collecting duct is less permeable to water, so less water is reabsorbed and a larger volume of dilute urine is produced.
